claim: === source_strength — how good is the evidence? ===
peer-reviewed              published at a refereed venue
preprint                   not refereed
vendor                     the source sells the thing it describes. Use even for a paper,
if its authors sell the product
own-measurement            measured in this project
source-absence             an observation that a source OMITS something — a missing
baseline, an unnamed device, an absent denominator. Not a measurement
training-data-unverified   believed, not confirmed at source
=== maturity — is this settled SCIENCE? ===
A separate question from source_strength. A peer-reviewed paper can be single-source;
a preprint can state something long established.
This column is what makes the scope boundary executable. The boundary itself is stated
in GUIDE.md section 3 and nowhere else -- read it there.
established     independently replicated, AND used as a premise by work outside the
originating group
converging      replicated, but the field is still arguing for it
disputed        a serious published rebuttal exists. NOT the same as state=contested:
maturity asks whether the science is settled, state asks where this
project stands on it. A row can be maturity=disputed, state=verified
single-source   one group, no independent confirmation
unexamined      nobody has tried to break it
=== maturity_basis — WHICH signal was found ===
Required whenever maturity is set. Without it the assessment is an assertion.
replicated-by:<who>        an independent group obtained it
premise-in:<source>        later work builds on it without re-arguing it
survived:<source>          a published attempt to refute it failed
rebutted-by:<source>       a published rebuttal exists
age-and-use:<years>        old and still in use
cross-community:<fields>   more than one field rests on it
value-drifts               the reported number differs between sources — NOT established
originator-strongest       the largest version is the originating group's — the smaller
independent version may be established, the large one is not
provisional                the scout's judgement from what it read. NOT verified.
A claim a chapter rests on may not stay provisional
=== class — how long will it hold? ===
durable      expect it to hold in five years
convention   how it is done now
volatile     settings, versions, prices, model names, benchmark figures
=== state — where does it stand in THIS project? ===
verified | contested | superseded | unverified
A superseded row is never deleted: that something WAS believed is the lesson.
